Parts.Description: Green field, a concrete launch apron, a crawler road, a landing target and a parking apron.
Parts.Name: Spaceport Grounds

Parts.Description: The control centre behind the Shiba: big windows, a flight tower, a dish and a tall antenna.
Parts.Name: Mission Control

Parts.Description: A round concrete launch platform with a blast wall, two floodlight masts and cable cabinets.
Parts.Name: Launch Platform

Parts.Description: The star of the show: a tall white rocket with red fins, a red nose cone and a ring of black engines.
Parts.Name: Big Red Rocket

Parts.Description: A big scoreboard sign that counts down to the next bonk. T minus ten!
Parts.Name: Countdown Board

Parts.Description: An orange steel tower with three platforms, swing arms that reach the rocket and a beacon on top.
Parts.Name: Service Gantry

Parts.Description: A six-wheel-style moon buggy with a cargo box, a mast and a little dish.
Parts.Name: Moon Rover

Parts.Description: Two big white fuel spheres on stands, a long bullet tank and an orange pipe between them.
Parts.Name: Fuel Tanks

Parts.Description: Two big radar dishes that listen to the stars, plus a small control cabin and a mast.
Parts.Name: Dish Array

Parts.Description: A little diner with a red roof, three umbrella tables and a rocket sign on a pole.
Parts.Name: Astro Cafe

Parts.Description: A gold-foil moon lander on four legs with a white crew cabin, two fuel tanks and an antenna.
Parts.Name: Lunar Lander

Parts.Description: A white observatory with a round dome, a slit for the big telescope, an annex and a porch.
Parts.Name: Dome Observatory

Parts.Description: Three long rows of blue solar panels with a battery box and a power hut.
Parts.Name: Solar Field

Parts.Description: A huge white hangar with a giant door, a navy roof, a little office and a flag.
Parts.Name: Assembly Hangar

Parts.Description: A scorched crew capsule that just landed, with its big striped parachute lying on the grass.
Parts.Name: Return Capsule

Parts.Description: A tall whirling arm with a crew gondola and a counterweight. Hold on to your helmet!
Parts.Name: Training Centrifuge

Parts.Description: Two white domes joined by a tunnel on rusty red ground, with an airlock, tanks and red rocks.
Parts.Name: Mars Habitat

Parts.Description: A grey moon crater with big boulders and a small flag planted in the middle.
Parts.Name: Moon Garden

Parts.Description: A white space shuttle resting on its stand, with delta wings, a tail fin and three engines.
Parts.Name: Space Shuttle

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a model of a space station high on a pylon, with long modules and four solar wings.
Parts.Name: Orbital Station
